pattern_id: State divergence when leader executes before broadcasting Commit then crashes
description: State divergence occurs when leader executes command on Fast Path before broadcasting Commit, then crashes. Recovery assigns different dependencies, causing different execution orders.
trigger_condition: 1) Leader achieves Fast Path, sets status=COMMITTED. 2) executeCommands goroutine executes before bcastCommit. 3) Leader crashes. 4) Recovery recalculates dependencies due to new conflicts. 5) handleCommit overwrites EXECUTED instance's deps without checking status.
root_cause: Race condition between execution and commit broadcast. handleCommit does NOT check for EXECUTED status before overwriting Seq/Deps, allowing state downgrade from EXECUTED to COMMITTED.
fix_approach: 1) Add EXECUTED status check in handleCommit. 2) Ensure bcastCommit happens before execution. 3) Protect EXECUTED instances from dependency modification.
